title: Dark-mode codemod stranded opacity modifiers on the dark half, making 5 light-mode surfaces fully opaque
detail: `bg-white/10` was rewritten as `bg-white dark:bg-gray-900/10`. The light class lost its /10, so what was a subtle translucent divider or hover wash is now solid. Sites: AudioPlayer 244, BookCard 66, BookDetail 521, DailyWisdomModal 42, StatsView 215. Every one of them also renders backdrop-blur that is now pointless because the surface behind it is fully covered.

title: Daily Wisdom close button is invisible in light mode
detail: The codemod turned `bg-white/20` into `bg-white`, and the button keeps `text-white`. White glyph on a solid white circle — the only way to dismiss the modal cannot be seen.

title: `dark:` appended after an arbitrary-variant selector retargets the wrong element
detail: `[&::-webkit-slider-thumb]:bg-white dark:bg-gray-900` — the dark class is not scoped to the pseudo-element, so in dark mode it paints the input's own background gray-900 instead of the thumb, and the thumb loses its dark styling entirely. Both the seek bar (215) and the volume slider (239).

title: Play/pause icon is invisible in dark mode
detail: `bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 text-black` — the surface flips to near-black but the glyph stays text-black. The primary control of the audio player disappears.

title: Codemod darkened text that already sits on a permanently dark surface
detail: The player chrome is bg-gray-900/95 in both themes, so `text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500` makes contrast worse in dark mode rather than better. Seven sites: 135, 179, 199, 207, 226, 250, 257.

title: A rejected play() leaves the UI claiming it is playing
detail: Autoplay is blocked by default in most browsers until the user interacts. The catch logs and returns without setting isPlaying back to false, so the pause icon shows while nothing is audible. togglePlay at line 50 does not handle the rejection at all.

title: isPlaying has two independent writers
detail: togglePlay sets it optimistically while onPlay/onPause set it from the element's real state. They race whenever play() is slow or rejected.

title: Conflicting display utilities on one element
detail: `flex items-center gap-4 hidden sm:flex` — `flex` and `hidden` both apply; it renders correctly only because of stylesheet source order.

title: Play/pause and speed buttons have no accessible name
detail: Rewind and forward carry aria-label; the primary play/pause control has none, and the speed toggle relies on title alone. A screen reader announces them as unlabelled buttons.

title: formatTime renders NaN:NaN when metadata never loads
detail: If the blob fails to decode, onLoadedMetadata never fires and duration stays 0 — but currentTime on a broken element can be NaN, which formats as 'NaN:NaN'.
